$comment: Contact properties the /enterprise form needs (FORM_FIX.md step A). Check each name first (GET /crm/properties/2026-09/contacts/{name}); create only the missing ones. gclid, gbraid and wbraid already exist: the live form references them. Every object under properties/optionalProperties is a complete POST body.

endpoints.$comment: Paths, body schemas (PropertyGroupCreate, BatchInputPropertyCreate/PropertyCreate: required groupName, name, label, type, fieldType; formField = usable in HubSpot forms) and scope from HubSpot crm-properties-v2026-09 OpenAPI, fetched 2026-09-30. Do not set hidden:true: hidden properties cannot be used in HubSpot.

properties.name: li_fat_id
properties.label: LinkedIn click id (li_fat_id)
properties.description: LinkedIn first-party ad tracking UUID (oa_ad_clids or the li_fat_id cookie). Sent as LINKEDIN_FIRST_PARTY_ADS_TRACKING_UUID with LinkedIn Conversions API lead events.

properties.name: fbclid
properties.label: Meta click id (fbclid)
properties.description: Meta ad click id (oa_ad_clids). Server-side lead events build fbc from it.

properties.name: ttclid
properties.label: TikTok click id (ttclid)
properties.description: TikTok ad click id (oa_ad_clids or the ttclid cookie). Sent as user.ttclid with TikTok Events API lead events.

optionalProperties.name: fbc
optionalProperties.label: Meta click cookie (fbc)
optionalProperties.description: Optional. The _fbc value fb.1.<ms>.<fbclid> with its original creation time. Preferred over rebuilding fbc from fbclid.

optionalProperties.name: msclkid
optionalProperties.label: Microsoft click id (msclkid)
optionalProperties.description: Optional. Microsoft Advertising click id (oa_ad_clids or the _uetmsclkid cookie), for UET offline or CAPI lead conversions.
